The '''2018 [[Zambia Super League]]''', known as the '''[[MTN Group|MTN]]/[[Football Association of Zambia|FAZ]] Super Division''' for [[sponsor (commercial)|sponsorship]] purposes, was the 57th season of the top-tier [[association football]] league in [[Zambia]] which ran from 17 March to 28 October 2018.<ref>{{Cite web|date=14 February 2018|title=2018 SUPER LEAGUE SEASON KICK OFF DATE SET|url=http://zambianfootball.co.zm/2018-super-league-season-kick-off-date-set/|url-status=dead|access-date=4 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190424070304/http://zambianfootball.co.zm/2018-super-league-season-kick-off-date-set/|archive-date=24 April 2019}}</ref> ZESCO United claimed their 7th league title and thus retained it having won it [[2017 Zambia Super League|the previous season]].<ref>{{cite web|date=26 September 2018|title=Back to back!! Zesco United bag 2018 league title|website=ZamFoot|url=https://zambianfootball.co.zm/back-to-back-zesco-united-bag-2018-league-title/|access-date=20 July 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|first=Elvince|last=Joshua|date=26 September 2018|title=Kenya's top striker Jesse Were on target as Zesco United are crowned champions|url=https://www.goal.com/en-gh/news/kenyas-top-striker-jesse-were-on-target-as-zesco-united-are/1m2w4zq367c8a1e98j3c97cnxh|website=[[goal (website)|Goal]]|access-date=20 July 2022}}</ref>
